The test image shows a plant with:
- Clear mosaic/mottle pattern — irregular yellow-green patches on leaves
- Leaf distortion and puckering/crinkling
- General chlorosis intermingled with normal green
- No discrete necrotic spots, no fungal growth, no lesions

This pattern strongly suggests a viral disease, most consistent with Cucumber Mosaic Virus. Let me confirm with one reference image.

The reference CMV image shows severe filiform/shoestring leaves from CMV on tomato — a more extreme form. The test image shows a pepper-like plant with yellow-green mosaic mottling and mild leaf distortion, which are classic CMV symptoms at an earlier/milder stage or on a different host. The mosaic pattern without necrotic spots, ring lesions, or fungal growth best fits CMV.
